== Summary ==

Crop rectangle <code>(133, 601, 1298, 2230)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>c818d03a81a2a62743c7941ca3033e863546d2d725148ff73f974ae3cb956fc8</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
